svg.title: TravelMate current system entity relationship diagram
svg.desc: A consolidated entity relationship diagram of the 24 persisted models in the current Prisma schema, grouped into trip planning, identity and operations, plan access, and marketplace data.
svg.text: 24 persisted models · PostgreSQL / Prisma · Updated for monthly AI allowance and test checkout
Saved trips, version history, generation idempotency, feedback and actual visits

g.text: PK id · FK userId? · FK itineraryId?
PK id · FK userId · FK tripId?

svg.text: ? = nullable FK · deleting a trip cascades versions and clears optional trip references
Authentication, account notices, audit, moderation and rate limiting
Moderation.subjectId and AuditEvent.targetId are scalar identifiers, not FK relationships.
RateLimitBucket is keyed independently and has no User relation.
Subscriptions, test checkout, admin grants and monthly generation tracking

g.text: PK key · FK userId · FK actorId

svg.text: Monthly usage reservations and charges live on ItineraryGeneration in panel 1.
GenerationTracking is independent; it does not reference a User or subscription.
Persisted listing, booking, payment-record and review models; presence does not mean live payments
Listing.ownerId is a User FK; the current User role enum has no separate owner role.
Booking/listing records remain schema data; no real payment processing is implied.
Foreign-key relationship; 1:N = one parent to many child rows
PK primary key · FK foreign key · UQ unique constraint · ? nullable · Scalar IDs shown without a relationship are not foreign keys.
User appears in multiple panels for readability; each occurrence represents the same users table. Enum definitions and JSON internals are omitted.
